Process law P9 forces the engine edit into its own commit ahead of the landing, and the lander's preflight requires a clean tree, so by the time `land lever` measures its source side (git show <base>:engine/rl_after/_merged_recover.py) the flip is already HEAD. The flip commit therefore carries the engine_head restamp of all four carriers that name it, through the estate's established writer for exactly this case (docs/evidence/staircase_fix_2026-08-20/sfx_restamp.py, byte-carried from d8_restamp.py) — the lesson of repair 1590a37, which fixed the restamp the ORDER 44 edit commit 1446dec left out. Without the restamp riding the flip commit this landing HALTS at the lineage step with 'base-commit engine_head disagrees with that tree's expected_boot'.

lineage.doc: THE STAIRCASE FIX ADOPTION (ORDER 44), VARIANT A RAW, UNCONSERVED. RL_O44_LVLMONO — the level-axis band monotoniser priced 2026-08-20 at docs/evidence/staircase_fix_2026-08-20/ and delivered PRICED, NOT ADOPTED — moves from default OFF to shipped default 'ratchet' (VARIANT A, RAW), behind the declared kill-switch RL_O44_LVLMONO=0, through the exact lane the D8 adoption (register v798) and the bake before it (register v780) used: the default literal in the engine changes and data/model_config.json is NOT touched, so config_sha256 is UNMOVED and no certifying build can CARRY the name. Variant A is the RUNNING-MAX (ratchet) form, non-decreasing in level by construction over the exact knot set of the fitted trees. The fix repairs a LAW 3 (NO CLIFFS) VIOLATION recorded at register v806: the five pinned quantile forests read at conditional_prior.py:164-167 are piecewise-constant and carry no monotonicity constraint on the level feature, so 44 of 86 thin-evidence rows would price HIGHER on a LOWER round-23 score. LAW 9, STATED NOT NETTED: this board MINTS +8,460 SCAR = +1.2220% (692,296 -> 700,756), 42.3x the 200-SCAR band_scar rail. That is a LAW 9 BREACH ON ITS FACE and it is ACCEPTED BY OWNER WORD, cited below. It is recorded as an ACCEPTED EXCEPTION, never as a pass. THE CONSERVATION LEG IS REJECTED ON PRINCIPLE by the same owner, in his own words, and the adopted dial value is 'ratchet' rather than 'ratchet+conserve' for that reason. SCAFFOLDING: the monotoniser acts on the OUTPUT of a surface whose defect is at the FIT; it is classified for retirement at the end-of-season rebake per the owner's schedule, and its removal is a MUST-MOVE PROOF of that rebake.

commit_message:
THE STAIRCASE FIX ADOPTED — ORDER 44, VARIANT A RAW (ratchet, UNCONSERVED), ON THE OWNER'S RE-RULING. The board moves 68be10c7 -> b3e8da99 (692,296 -> 700,756). LAW 9 BREACH ACCEPTED BY OWNER WORD, stated not netted.

OWNER WORD 2026-08-21, VERBATIM: "I misunderstood the A and B difference. I think based on those
explanations, A raw I prefer. Lock that in, unconserved."

THIS RE-RULES an earlier word in the same session ("Happy to lock in 1.22% and variant B"). That word
drove this seat's first act, which HALTED BEFORE THE FLIP at 36f1122: the no-arb reading of B raw was
measured for the first time and showed FOUR new buy-rail breaches with NONE removed. The owner was
shown it, the A/B difference was re-explained, and he changed his choice. A measurement taken before
the board moved changed a decision — which is the whole point of taking it.

TWO RULINGS RIDE WITH IT, both verbatim. ON CONSERVATION: "in principle I don't like 'enforcing
conservation' as that's another mechanism that gets baked in... If we want to conserve, I'd prefer to
find a lever to remove value that works on its own" — which is why the adopted value is 'ratchet' and
NOT 'ratchet+conserve'. ON THE ARBITRAGE READING: "happy to waive the no arb reading for this", given
AFTER the supervisor told him explicitly that A raw was expected to breach similarly to B raw.

THE WAIVER COVERS THE BAND RAILS, NOT THE CLASS LAW, AND NOT THE MEASUREMENT. F4 was checked against
floor 1.03 / buy rail 1.14 on the registered W2 basis BEFORE this landing ran and PASSED. The complete
A-raw no-arb reading was emitted as part of this act — all five arms side by side — and every breach is
recorded plainly beside the live board's own cell. A waiver of a gate is not a licence to leave a
number unmeasured.

LAW 9, STATED NOT NETTED: this board MINTS +8,460 SCAR = +1.2220% against a 200-SCAR (±0.029%) rail —
42.3x. A BREACH ON ITS FACE, ACCEPTED BY OWNER WORD, recorded as an ACCEPTED EXCEPTION and never as a
pass. A raw is the arm the owner's 1.22% figure was actually quoted from.

WHAT THIS REPAIRS: register v806's LAW 3 (NO CLIFFS) VIOLATION. The five pinned quantile forests read
at conditional_prior.py:164-167 are piecewise-constant and carry no monotonicity constraint on the
level feature, so a player's band steps DOWN on a RISING level and 44 of 86 thin-evidence rows would
price HIGHER on a LOWER round-23 score. The four rows the fix exists for land at their measured
variant-A values: Kondogiannis 359->409, Dolan 247->311, West 381->383, Hayes 180->250 — all four RISE.

THE LANE: the default literal in engine/rl_after/_merged_recover.py moves '0' -> 'ratchet' and
data/model_config.json is NOT touched — so config_sha256 is UNMOVED and a canonical build can only ship
the baked-in default, never CARRY the name. conditional_prior.py is not edited, no forest is refitted,
cm_400.pkl and q97m.pkl are read exactly as they are. KILL-SWITCH: RL_O44_LVLMONO=0 restores 68be10c7
BYTE-EXACT, proved by build here, with the positive control that switch-off != switch-on.

engine_head MOVED AT THE FLIP COMMIT immediately before this one, restamp riding it (the lesson of
1590a37). It is declared unmoved to the lander because that is the measured truth of THIS transaction,
not because the adoption left the engine alone; the lineage invariants say so in words.

SCAFFOLDING: classified for retirement at the end-of-season rebake per the owner's schedule.

LANDED BY tools/land lever (PLAN_v6 PACKAGE 2a) — ITS FIRST REAL LANDING. NOT PUSHED. Register v808
pending; the register is the supervisor's pen and is untouched.
